title: Sample-region DSP is discoverable through the design-time capability surface

installed_sdk.rationale: The sample-region authoring and proof types are public Pulp host headers, while the delivery remains pending its complete downstream and installed-consumer evidence.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: D4 adds the design-time capability and SDK catalog surface; it does not add a Timeline CLI operation.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: D4 adds no offline Timeline MCP operation.

live_product_control.rationale: The runtime broker and live topology operations are owned by C4, not this catalog packet.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: The generated agent capability manifest publishes signal.sample-region with typed bindings for the bounded sample-region host surface.
